The '''SB-920 laser cannon''' was manufactured by [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel Galactic Defense]]. They were manufactured exclusively for [[Imperial starship]]s and the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. It was manned by one [[Imperial gunner/Legends|gunner]] who was stationed in a pressurized enclosure. They fired through magnetic [[Force field/Legends|Force field]] ports.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]'' identified the Death Star's laser cannons as being [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] L-s 4.9 laser cannons, but later sources identified them as Borstel SB-920 cannons.
